reviews.title: Ads galore
reviews.text:
This app is basically an ad platform for movies. The user uses it to view details of movies. Trailers are ads for movies. 

It’s a win win situation, the user gets to view the ad (trailer) they want to see, the movie/ show gets exposure, possibly leading to a cinema viewing or blue ray purchase. 

So WHY do I need to see an ad before seeing the ad (trailer) I want to view? If any product shoves their ad down my throat I will proactively not buy that product. 

IMDB app itself is difficult to navigate with overly complicated design. 

PLEASE UP VOTE THIS REVIEW IF YOU AGREE!!

reviews.title: No Longer Support iPhone 8
reviews.text: The app just says that it no longer supports iPhone 8 but if you click on a direct link then it opens the app just fine. It’s pants that you claim that old technology isn’t supported in an app when every other app works just fine. Thumbs down for imdb.

reviews.title: Can no longer use
reviews.text:
Annoying I can no longer use due to outdated iOS. Was great. Needs a version that works on older iOS.
I post a review months ago when the IOS issues arose. I think what is more disappointing is that there is no response from the developers. 90% of reviews since June are 1 star. And they can’t even be bothered to acknowledge. Very sad.

reviews.title: Hate Hate Hate
reviews.text: Hate version 16.1 and hate the new search bar, wrong position and too cluttered, hate to delete the IMDb app and I installed Rotten Tomatoes instead, such a shame, I’ve been a member of the IMDb community for 20+ years but never will I use this app again unless it’s fixed
